evidence.description: The founding preregistration draft of 2026-11-17 (Spec 095 Stage 5 scoping, provenance of record) and this program's freeze record, which carries the frozen alignment procedure and the instantiated floors.

falsification_tests: P1 fails under both A1 and A2 — the procedure is not validated, and E2 does not run.
claims.text: The alignment procedure is validated by known answers. Under the registered alignment assumptions (A1 strict segment-parallel; A2 name-anchored free alignment), the frozen alignment procedure recovers the bilingual name correspondences of the development set (preregistration P1: both ICS 196 correspondences and at least one Androkles correspondence, at segment level, with no name information supplied to the procedure beyond the Greek texts themselves). This does not establish: that any Eteocypriot word is understood; E1 tests the procedure against Greek-side ground truth only.

evidence.description: The founding preregistration draft of 2026-11-17 (P2) and this program's freeze record, which instantiates the held-out census floor against the frozen census.

falsification_tests: Every registered candidate is NOT SUPPORTED or TOO THIN at scoring.
claims.text: At least one development-set candidate predicts held-out material. At least one registered morpheme or recurring-ending candidate, developed only on the development set, meets P2's success side (its registered held-out occurrence floor at its registered positions). This does not establish: that a surviving candidate's proposed meaning is correct — survival is a prediction result; meaning requires E3 and adjudication.

evidence.description: The founding preregistration draft of 2026-11-17 (P3) and the identifiability protocol, Standards of Record Part III.

falsification_tests: A survivor is scored SUPPORTED with no rival-construction record, or with an equally consistent rival unrecorded as NOT IDENTIFIABLE.
claims.text: Surviving candidates are identifiable or are reported as not. Every E2 survivor's standing is set by its E3 rival-construction record (P3): a survivor with an equally consistent incompatible rival is recorded NOT IDENTIFIABLE, whatever its E2 score, and no survivor is scored SUPPORTED without a completed rival-construction record. This does not establish: that a NOT IDENTIFIABLE candidate is false (Standards Part III, rule 5).

evidence.description: The founding preregistration draft of 2026-11-17 (EC-D4) and this program's freeze and outcome records, which state every outcome with its precision basis.

falsification_tests: A result is reported without its precision basis, or a below-floor leg is scored as a result.
claims.text: The study reports its own thinness honestly. Every outcome of the pilot is stated with its precision basis (Standards Part II), and any leg below its registered floor is recorded TOO THIN, including closures at freeze under floors that cannot be instantiated against the frozen census. This does not establish: that any outcome so reported is substantively correct; the claim governs the study's reporting, not its results.
